transport: timed producer -> Tauri main dispatch -> AppKit queue, synthetic native input; no direct model edits; not physical mouse/pen/input-to-photon
protocol: same Release binary, old/new/new/old; 16 x 1sec/60Hz gestures per draw/pan phase, 150ms gaps; discard first two gestures; idle recovery 5sec
status: complete: four accepted final-policy Release trials; no general latency improvement claim

excluded_trials.excluded_reason: QA foreground guard interrupted after gesture1 down; incomplete timed source, not a performance outlier exclusion

limitations: App-queued synthetic AppKit input, not physical mouse/pen or input-to-photon.
Two runs per mode; adjacent presentations are correlated, not independent experiments.
Event-age plus latest-handler time is an upper estimate with probe overlap; display-link phase and OS load may affect it.
Candidate-stage external/system load was observed; no controlled machine-wide isolation.
CPU covers Rust process only and all16 gestures; RSS is a short-run peak, not a long-term memory/leak result.
Background held progression uses nominal source-held seconds; per-pane service is cooperative, not a hard FPS guarantee.
